english.meaning: to move into a place where the speaker is
english.note: 搬入來住 means move in and live here.

exampleSentences.english: Don’t live in Fanling—why not move here instead?
exampleSentences.traditional: 唔粉嶺住啊，唔搬入來住吖嗎。
exampleSentences.jyutping: m4 fan2 leng5 zyu6 aa3 m4 bun1 jap6 lai4 zyu6 aa1 maa3

exampleSentences.english: Half, then? Might as well move it all the way in—it makes no difference.
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉半個，不如褪晒入來喇，橫掂都係囖。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam2 bun3 go3 bat1 jyu4 tan3 saai3 jap6 lai4 laa1 waang4 dim6 dou1 hai6 lo1
